name: wg-sdd-kit-plugin
description: Specs-Driven Development (SDD) plugin: Pre-SDD PRD agents, gated workflow (feature spec -> backlog -> plan -> publish), security skills (threat model, code review, secrets audit), /council + /council-v2 truth docs, agents for analysis/QA/docs, templates, and Jira/Confluence automation. Stack-agnostic — pair with a stack plugin (e.g. authpoint-cloud-plugin) for coding conventions.
